crossRefs.note: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to…
He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day.…
“The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,
I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of…
I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in…
As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who…
Besides hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that…
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…
If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he…
Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
translations.bsb: Consider how great Melchizedek was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.
translations.kjv: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
translations.asv: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the chief spoils.
